Title: nebula-mesh: Signed-poll nonce LRU is in-memory and bounded; replay survives restart + eviction
Description: `internal/api/pop/nonce.go:25,40,86` + `internal/api/server.go:38` — the signed-poll nonce cache is an in-process LRU sized at 65,536 entries. `internal/api/updates.go:31` sets `pollClockSkew = 5 * time.Minute` as the replay window.
